title.en: A picture is a table of numbers

t.zh: 这条路线从数表开始，不需要先会相机几何。通过<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>查看表示约定：指出位置、改变一格，再让电路读取右邻和当前位置的差。彩色样例约定按 R、G、B 排列，数值在 0 到 1。
t.en: This route starts from tables and needs no camera geometry. Open <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> and the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> for the representation: locate a cell, change one cell, then wire the difference between it and its right neighbour. Colour examples use R, G, B order with values from 0 to 1.

after.zh: 同一张数表换一个读取位置，得到的值就可能不同；图像运算首先要保证“取到了哪里”。邻居差把这种定位用于比较，为后面的局部处理打下基础。
after.en: Reading another position can change the value obtained from the same table. Before computing, establish where the input comes from. Neighbour differences use that positioning to make a comparison, ready for local processing.

brief.zh: 写出高亮那一格的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted cell.

hint.zh: x 是第几列，y 是第几行，都从 0 数起。
hint.en: x is the column and y the row, both counted from 0.

why.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
why.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

brief.zh: 把 (1, 0) 的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>改成纯红，其他格子不动。
brief.en: Change the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 一个彩色<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是三个数，按红、绿、蓝的顺序。
hint.en: A colour <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is three numbers, in the order red, green, blue.

why.zh: 改的是 (0, 1)：x 和 y 写反了。(1, 0) 是第 0 行第 1 列。
why.en: That changes (0, 1): x and y swapped. (1, 0) is row 0, column 1.

t.zh: 需要在 x 的右侧再取一次值。使用取<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>、常数、相加和相减元件；坐标口上的 x、y 与前面格子的约定一致。
t.en: Read once more to the right of x. Use lookup, constant, addition and subtraction parts; x and y follow the same grid convention as before. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入一张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
brief.en: Given a <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

hint.zh: 取<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
hint.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row? (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)
